items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Boots told him, I know a way you can get a good first man, a clean tone, nice player. So let's try to get him. Several guys have been trying to get me down here. He brought my hometown, Jack Rampson. He's been trying to get me down here.

ctx.x: I know a question that I play with. Yes that's correct.

I'll play with it. Well then I came out on the house and came on down here and organized a band again in Temple, Texas. I stayed there and while I was there Boots had played with me in Houston and he heard that I was in Temple and Walter Wardell was here organizing the band. Boots told him, I know a way you can get a good first man, a clean tone, nice player. So let's try to get him. Several guys have been trying to get me down here. He brought my hometown, Jack Rampson.
